content: and the section that actually parses the json for the talent values is inside the character sections themselves, not the raw code on the right

the values are all given as one long string on a single line, prefaced by something like SM_0, which would be character 0 (actually character 1), so you need to SPLIT the values which takes the huge string and splits each value into it's own cell, but that's a huge horizontal array, so it get's transposed vertical
but the MATCH function is what is looking for SM_0 (in the above case of character 1)

since MATCH can look inside a cel for a partial result, other things can't, but that by itself only works ina single cell, but you need to search the entire json, so you need the arrayformula, which is how you make a single cell function apply to every cell in the selected range
wooooooow
INDEX is doing...something, i can't fully remember why it's needed, but it returns the cell position in the list that the MATCH array finds, i think

so i guess working backwards through the formula, it SEARCHES for SM_0, IFERROR removes errors if no character is selected, then it MATCHES that value across the ARRAYFORMULA to parse the json, SPLITS it into a horizontal array, then TRANSPOSES that array horizontal, that's the best i can explain
SM_0 is defined by this
which just takes CHARACTER 1 , extracts the number, does -1, to that number, then adds "SM_" to the front
it does this because this allows the user to use the dropdown boxes to re order their characters with the drop down menu
rather than just using a static value, it'l lupdate for whatever the user sets there
though i have no idea if anyone actually knows about that feature
